human_labels.judge_rationale: The artifact correctly requires fresh, separated, repeated full-suite evaluation and per-case evidence, but it omits the required diagnosis of whether any new miss is a skill defect or a bad case and the corresponding diagnose-revise-full-sweep loop. It also adds a clean-checkout sweep after every individual run, which is materially unnecessary for establishing the requested evaluation evidence; isolation can be enforced without repeating that maintenance operation after each run.

observations.value:
Re-evaluate all cases—A, B, and C—not just B—to detect regressions.

Because agent output is nondeterministic, run fresh blind evaluations 2–3 times per case, with one context-free runner per run. Each runner sees only its case input and the edited skill, never the bar or expected output. Grade each artifact separately using a fresh judge given only the artifact, the case’s bar, and the skill’s first principles.

Before claiming success, report:

- Each case’s post-edit pass rate.
- Evidence-backed verdicts citing specific artifact text or locations for every part of each bar.
- Confirmation that B’s original gap is resolved.
- Confirmation that A and C still pass, showing the B-focused edit caused no regressions.
- A clean-checkout sweep after every run, with any leaked changes removed.

The fix worked only when all three cases clear their required pass-rate bars; a single green run—especially for B—is insufficient.
